Fits and geometry were counted separately through the actual activation helper with fixed mock terminal dimensions, not asserted as complete app DOM layout.

probe.interpretation: 20 telemetry updates in one burst still render one frame; forced layout/mount calls change 1/2 to 0/0. Other controls stay unchanged and pending frames settle at zero.
